name: com.hyprmx.android.sdk.overlay.HyprMXBrowserActivity
description: The HyprMX ad SDK opens this in-app browser for an advertiser's landing page or web-based ad experience. Users can navigate the page and close it from the HyprMX screen.
disableEffect: HyprMX ad landing pages will not open in the in-app browser; the host app's other features remain available.
